package flowexperiment

import (
	"reflect"
	"testing"

	"github.com/npillmayer/khipu"
	"github.com/npillmayer/khipu/dimen"
	"github.com/npillmayer/typography/glyphing/paragraph"
)

// Lock two KP lines whose second boundary differs from a fresh first-fit run.
// The continuation must not silently replace the accepted KP path with its own.
func TestE2DistinctKPPrefix(t *testing.T) {
	c := new(serviceCalls)
	cfg := flowConfig(c)
	cfg.Params.SpaceStretchPercent = 50
	cfg.Params.SpaceShrinkPercent = 33.3
	p, err := paragraph.Prepare(t.Context(), textInput("aaaa a a aa aa aaaa aa aaa a a aaa"), khipu.PrepareOptions{}, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	req := flowRequest(paragraph.FirstFit)
	ff, err := p.FlowStart(t.Context(), req)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	req.Params.Breaker = paragraph.KnuthPlass
	kp, err := p.FlowStart(t.Context(), req)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(ff.Initial().BreakPositions, []uint64{9, 15, 23, 31, 34}) || !reflect.DeepEqual(kp.Initial().BreakPositions, []uint64{9, 20, 29, 34}) {
		t.Fatal("distinct-prefix oracle changed")
	}
	before := c.snapshot()
	second := kp.Initial().VList.Lines()[1]
	ha := second.Top + second.Height
	ref, err := flowToFrames(t.Context(), p, kp, ha, 30*dimen.BP, 1000, false)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	got, err := flowToFrames(t.Context(), p, kp, ha, 30*dimen.BP, 1000, true)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	compareFlow(t, kp.Initial(), ref, got, 2, 30*dimen.BP)
	noBaseShaping(t, before, c.snapshot())
}
